Overview
Welcome to the Hibernate Association Mapping Project! This project aims to provide a comprehensive example and guide for using Hibernate, a popular Java-based Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) framework, for handling association mappings in your database-backed applications. Association mapping plays a crucial role in defining relationships between different entities in a relational database, and understanding how to model these relationships effectively is vital for building robust applications.

Features
Step-by-step Guides: This project includes detailed step-by-step guides and examples on how to set up and work with different types of association mappings, including one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many relationships.

Sample Application: We've included a sample Java application that demonstrates real-world use cases of association mapping. You can use this application as a reference or as a starting point for your own projects.

Best Practices: Learn about best practices and common pitfalls when working with association mappings in Hibernate. We provide insights and recommendations to help you make informed decisions.

Contributions Welcome: We welcome contributions from the community to improve and expand this resource. Whether you're fixing a typo, adding new examples, or suggesting enhancements, your contributions are valuable.
